einzeiler: Kevin Godley looks back on directing the Beatles music video for Real Love.
kurzfassung: Director and musician Kevin Godley discusses his long career and the creative process behind the 1995 Beatles music video for Real Love. He explains how he combined archival material with visual magic and shares behind-the-scenes stories from the editing room. The conversation highlights his unique working relationships with the surviving members of the band.
stichpunkte: Kevin Godley reflects on a career spanning over fifty years across 10cc, Godley & Cream, and music video direction.
He discusses directing the music video for the Beatles track Real Love in 1995.
Godley utilized archival footage and documentary elements to capture the band's enduring sense of humor.
He added surreal and magical touches, such as a piano rising from the Mersey, to complement the historical footage.
To help with the editing process due to a quiet guide vocal, he recorded his own temporary singing track over the song.
This temporary work tape accidentally leaked onto the internet, creating a rare recording featuring his vocals alongside the band.
He filmed the surviving members separately and cleverly edited the footage to make them appear together.
He reflects on being a trusted collaborator who had previously worked individually with George Harrison, Paul McCartney, and Ringo Starr.

clips.text: The guest explains that his professional history with Paul McCartney preceded their time living near each other.

clips.hook: Adding magical elements to historical footage
clips.text: The director points out that any visual project about the group requires an injection of surrealism rather than relying solely on documentaries.

clips.hook: Recording a temporary guide vocal for the edit
clips.text: Because the rough mix lacked clarity, the editor recorded his own voice over the track to help pace the cuts, which later surfaced online.
The guest reflects on interacting with every member of the band except for John Lennon, calling the experience a cherished memory.
